## MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the Current Market Regime?
CAUTION: low volatility (Vol: 18.4%) but very narrow participation (Breadth: 1/8), signaling complacency with concentrated leadership.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy & Chemicals ABOVE TREND: TRMET (1W: +13.70% | 1M: +24.63%) ABOVE TREND; SASA (1W: +10.70% | 1M: +5.91%) ABOVE TREND; TUPRS (1W: +5.19% | 1M: +40.34%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology & Telecom BELOW TREND: TCELL (1W: -4.42% | 1M: -6.07%) BELOW TREND, TTKOM (1W: -7.14% | 1M: -11.76%) BELOW TREND; Transportation BELOW TREND: THYAO (1W: -5.31% | 1M: -3.93%) BELOW TREND.

## STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
TRMET (1W: +13.70% | 1M: +24.63%) ABOVE TREND; SASA (1W: +10.70% | 1M: +5.91%) ABOVE TREND; ASELS (1W: +8.18% | 1M: +3.47%) ABOVE TREND; OYAKC (1W: +5.45% | 1M: +2.90%) ABOVE TREND; TUPRS (1W: +5.19% | 1M: +40.34%) ABOVE TREND.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
TOASO (1W: -8.69% | 1M: -17.60%) BELOW TREND; EKGYO (1W: -8.64% | 1M: -10.74%) BELOW TREND; TTKOM (1W: -7.14% | 1M: -11.76%) BELOW TREND; ULKER (1W: -6.02% | 1M: -11.41%) BELOW TREND; HALKB (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -17.29%) BELOW TREND.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Up momentum: TRMET (1W: +13.70% | 1M: +24.63%) ABOVE TREND; SASA (1W: +10.70% | 1M: +5.91%) ABOVE TREND; ASELS (1W: +8.18% | 1M: +3.47%) ABOVE TREND. Down momentum: TOASO (1W: -8.69% | 1M: -17.60%) BELOW TREND; EKGYO (1W: -8.64% | 1M: -10.74%) BELOW TREND; TTKOM (1W: -7.14% | 1M: -11.76%) BELOW TREND.

## SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Banking Sector Outlook?
Defensive stance; AKBNK (1W: +1.65% | 1M: -16.49%) RECOVERY while ISCTR (1W: -5.56% | 1M: -14.44%) BELOW TREND and HALKB (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -17.29%) BELOW TREND — sector remains weak and earnings/credit sensitivity is the risk.

8. Industrial Sector Outlook?
Mixed heavy industry: EREGL (1W: +2.22% | 1M: +8.36%) ABOVE TREND and ASELS ABOVE TREND provide pockets of strength, but FROTO (1W: -5.50% | 1M: -8.62%) BELOW TREND and TOASO BELOW TREND show residual cyclicality.

9. Energy & Chemicals Outlook?
Leadership but narrow: TRMET (1W: +13.70% | 1M: +24.63%) ABOVE TREND, PETKM (1W: +5.16% | 1M: +13.16%) ABOVE TREND and TUPRS ABOVE TREND are driving the sector, but watch SISE (1W: -1.76% | 1M: -3.73%) BELOW TREND for divergence.

## PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Exercise caution: trim broad beta and take profits on crowded winners while maintaining selective exposure to Energy & Chemicals leaders and high-quality industrials; raise cash or hedge sector concentration given narrow breadth.

## NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
TRMET (1W: +13.70% | 1M: +24.63%) ABOVE TREND for continuation; TUPRS (1W: +5.19% | 1M: +40.34%) ABOVE TREND on oil/earnings sensitivity; SASA (1W: +10.70% | 1M: +5.91%) ABOVE TREND for momentum; ISCTR (1W: -5.56% | 1M: -14.44%) BELOW TREND as a barometer for banking weakness.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
Energy & Chemicals for leadership continuation and earnings/oil flow-through; Banking & Finance for credit/FX sensitivity and potential spillover if breadth deteriorates further.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
XU100 needs a >2% pick-up to signal broader follow-through; a >3% drop would likely flip breadth to outright risk-off. Key catalysts: Turkish macro prints (inflation, FX), CBRT commentary, oil price moves, and major corporate earnings.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
Low-volatility, narrow-market CAUTION regime: Energy & Chemicals are driving gains while most sectors lag. Maintain selective exposure to momentum leaders but reduce broad beta and hedge concentrated positions given the one-sector leadership and shallow breadth.
